market: US/UK/CA/AU (English-speaking, Amazon KDP + Etsy Printables focus)
methodology_note: WebFetch access to amazon.com, etsy.com, pinterest.com, trends.google.com, tiktok.com, reddit.com and several third-party blogs was blocked by the session's network egress policy in this environment. Findings below are based on WebSearch snippets/summaries, one purpose-built Pinterest research artifact, and publicly reported facts only. No sales figures, review counts, or rankings were invented; unverifiable claims are flagged as such in the raw research files under research/raw/.

themes.name_ja: コージー・キッチンウィッチ（ハーブ薬草魔女）
themes.key_signal: Pinterest Hobbies Trend Report 2026: herbal apothecary +595%; Practical Magic 2 movie release Sept 2026 as timing catalyst

themes.name_ja: グランマコア（おばあちゃんの台所・編み物・刺繍世界観）
themes.key_signal: Pinterest Spring Trend Report 2026: grandma core kitchen +545%, dark cottagecore kitchen +915%. Almost no dedicated Amazon/Etsy coloring products found yet.

themes.name_ja: コージー・カフェ＆ブックストア
themes.key_signal: Multiple independent Amazon and Etsy listings for cozy bakery/bookstore/coffee shop themes; strong horizontal series potential.

themes.name_ja: カピバラ×コージー／コテージコア
themes.key_signal: Present across Amazon, Etsy and referenced as a TikTok/character animal trend, but no independent Google Trends or Pinterest official confirmation found.

themes.name_ja: コテージコア・きのこ＆ガーデン
themes.key_signal: Broad established base across Amazon/Etsy; Pinterest garden inspiration ideas +940% (general gardening, not coloring-specific).

themes.name_ja: グレイスケール写実調ネイチャー＆動物塗り絵
themes.key_signal: Independently flagged by KDP niche blogs AND Etsy's own eRank blog as the fastest-growing adult niche for 2026; less saturated than line-art, but harder to mass-produce consistently with AI (lower AI-fit score).

themes.name_ja: ボールド＆イージー・キュートアニマル
themes.decision: テストする（差別化必須）
themes.key_signal: Established, high-demand, cross-market style reported by BookRiot as an actual industry controversy (proof of real market weight). Heavily saturated; must be paired with a specific micro-theme to differentiate.

themes.name_ja: ダークアカデミア・ゴシック図書館
themes.key_signal: Low competition per KDP blogs, but multiple similar Amazon products launched within a few months in 2026 — early sign of the niche filling up quickly. No Pinterest/SNS confirmation.

themes.name_ja: スプーキーキュート（クリーピーキュート）
themes.decision: 見送り（Cozy Witchの季節派生として吸収）
themes.key_signal: Real Etsy listings exist; TikTok 'cute horror/cutegore' aesthetic referenced, but strongly seasonal (Halloween window) with no evergreen path of its own.

themes.name_ja: オリジナルキャラクター・カワイイ塗り絵
themes.decision: 見送り（Sanrio等IP寄せは禁止方針のため差別化困難）
themes.key_signal: Established demand tied to character-goods culture (Sanrio etc.), but the demand is largely IP-driven; original kawaii characters face high competition without infringing on existing IP.
